tasks.short: Monitor productivity and quality against procedures.

steps.what: Monitor quality against the operating procedures.
Ensure compliance with the standard procedures.

tasks.design: The data manager watches the work against the standard operating procedures. Completion means a required record exists, not a score of a person. They judge compliance and write the note. No dashboard of individual performance is built. The note is not sent on its own.
tasks.previous_blocker: Quality is watched in the room and then copied into a private sheet of names.
tasks.enabler_now: A procedure record can show that a step was completed. It cannot judge the person.
tasks.still_hard: Judging quality stays with the data manager. A score of a worker is not this task.
tasks.human_edge: The data manager watches the work and judges compliance. A record of completion is not a score.
tasks.altitude: Watching quality and judging compliance stay with the data manager. No individual performance dashboard is built.

reach.task: Follow a procedure the data manager has judged
reach.learn: The judgement was the data manager's

evidence.claim: Dutch works-council law requires consent before a dashboard shows an individual worker's performance. This design does not build that dashboard. Other countries set their own rules.
The data manager watches procedure completion and judges quality. A list of completed records is not a score of a person.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the work is under way and ends when the data manager has noted compliance. No dashboard of individual performance is built. The digest names a Dutch consent rule for such a dashboard, and other countries differ.
The fields are the procedure name, whether the required record exists, and the note they write. The staff member produces the record. If it is missing, they look at the work. Nothing scores a person.
The prior treats the task as amplify. The steps agree that it stays a human watch. They add only a note of what they saw, not a score.
Upkeep is keeping the procedure list aligned with the note.
unknowns: Whether a works council must see this watch even without a dashboard.
Which procedures are in the standard set.
research_questions: Must a works council see this watch even without a dashboard?
Which procedures are in the standard set?

already_counted.description: Monitoring quality against the operating procedures stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the procedure list aligned with the note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If procedure completion is not recorded as a field, the whole watch stays, and the low end is the monitoring, which stays either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare requested formatting for data sets.

steps.what: Prepare the requested formatting for codes.

tasks.design: The data manager sets the formatting rules that were requested. A program on the {DATA_PLATFORM} applies those rules to columns and codes. A native export is tried first. They review the result and accept it. The file stores that version. Nothing changes a value and nothing chooses the format.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same column order and code list are reapplied by hand for each request.
tasks.enabler_now: A format specification the person wrote can be applied by a program, after the system's own export is tried.
tasks.still_hard: The request still has to be read. A wrong code list is the data manager's to catch.
tasks.human_edge: The data manager sets the formatting rules and accepts the result. The program applies only those rules.
tasks.altitude: Setting the formatting rules and accepting the result stay with the data manager. The file holds only the version they accept.

reach.task: Use a data set the data manager formatted
reach.learn: The rules were set by the data manager

evidence.claim: pharmaverse admiral derives ADaM datasets and rtables builds tables. The digest ties that to preparing tables and graphs. A model does not compute the numbers.
The person sets the format rules. A program can apply them. A model does not change the values.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a format is requested and ends when the accepted formatting is on the file. The data manager sets the rules. A native export is tried before a custom program. Nothing changes a value.
The fields are the column, the code, the order, and their acceptance. They write the rule. If the native export already matches, they use it. A missing code is filled by them, not by a model.
The prior treats the task as automate. The steps agree that applying a written rule can be a program. They disagree by keeping the rules and the review.
Upkeep is keeping the format rules aligned with the request.
unknowns: Whether the clinical system already exports this layout.
Who is allowed to request a format.
research_questions: Does the clinical system already export this layout?
Who is allowed to request a format?

already_counted.description: Preparing the formatting rules stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the format rules aligned with the request

approvals.approved_version: formatting the data manager accepted after setting the rules

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the requested format is already a native export, there is little left to save, and the low end is setting the rules and reviewing the result, which stay either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design forms for receiving, processing, and tracking.

steps.what: Design processing checks on the forms.
Build the tracking layout on the forms.

tasks.design: The data manager designs which fields the forms receive and which processing checks they carry. The {DATA_PLATFORM} lays out tracking fields from that accepted list, using its own form builder if it has one. They accept the forms. The file stores that version. Nothing chooses the fields.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each form is drawn again, including fields that were already agreed.
tasks.enabler_now: A form builder can lay out tracking fields from a list the person has already written.
tasks.still_hard: Which fields and which checks belong on the form is still the data manager's judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The data manager designs the fields and the checks, and accepts the forms.
tasks.altitude: Designing the fields and the checks stays with the data manager. The file holds the forms only after they accept them.

reach.task: Complete a form the data manager designed
reach.learn: The fields were chosen by the data manager

evidence.claim: A medicines-agency guideline expects validated edit checks, forbids a sponsor from changing investigator data without authority, expects a secure audit trail, and says a model may raise a query but must not correct the record. Rules specific to AI are deferred.
The person designs the fields and the checks. A form builder can lay out tracking fields from that list. It does not choose them.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the field list is known and ends when the accepted forms are on the file. The data manager designs the fields and the checks.
The fields are the form name, the item, the check, and their acceptance. They write the item. If the form builder cannot place it, they place it. Nothing adds a field.
The prior treats the task as automate. The steps agree that a layout from a written list can be built. They disagree by keeping the design and the acceptance.
Upkeep is keeping the field list aligned with the forms.
unknowns: Whether the clinical system has a form builder.
Which fields the protocol requires on the form.
research_questions: Does the clinical system have a form builder?
Which fields does the protocol require on the form?

already_counted.description: Designing the forms for receiving stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the field list aligned with the forms

approvals.approved_version: forms the data manager accepted after designing the fields and the checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the form builder cannot place the fields, the layout stays, and the low end is designing the fields and the checks, which stay either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare analysis listings and progress reports.

steps.what: Prepare analysis listings from the dataset.

tasks.design: Listings and activity or progress reports are built from the dataset by a program. The numbers are the dataset's numbers. The data manager reviews the listings and accepts the reports. The file stores that version. This is not a dashboard of staff performance, and a model does not write the figures.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same listing is rebuilt by hand before each progress meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: A program can rebuild a listing from a dataset when the column rules are already fixed.
tasks.still_hard: The data manager still has to see that the listing matches the question. A second programmer's independent table is not removed.
tasks.human_edge: The data manager reviews the listings and accepts the reports. The program does not write the numbers.

ambition.what: Refresh a progress listing when the dataset changes, rather than only before a monthly meeting.

tasks.altitude: Reviewing the listings and accepting the reports stay with the data manager. The file holds only the version they accept. No staff-performance dashboard is built.

reach.task: Read a progress report the data manager accepted
reach.learn: The figures were reviewed by the data manager

evidence.claim: Clinical Data Studio does automated listings review, query management, reconciliation, and audit-trail review.
pharmaverse admiral derives ADaM datasets and rtables builds tables. The digest ties that to preparing tables and graphs. A model does not compute the numbers.
Dutch works-council law requires consent before a dashboard shows an individual worker's performance. This design does not build that dashboard. Other countries set their own rules.
The numbers come from the dataset. A model does not write them. The person reviews the listing before it is filed.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the dataset is ready and ends when the accepted reports are on the file. The data manager reviews the listings. No dashboard of individual staff performance is built. Nothing writes a number.
The fields are the dataset name, the column, the figure, and their acceptance. The dataset produces the figure. If a column is missing, they stop the listing. A model does not fill it.
The prior treats the task as automate. The steps agree that a fixed listing can be rebuilt from the dataset. They disagree by keeping the review and by refusing a staff-performance dashboard.
Upkeep is keeping the listing columns aligned with the dataset.
unknowns: Whether a second programmer must still produce an independent table.
Whether progress here means the study or the staff. This design assumes the study.
research_questions: Must a second programmer still produce an independent table?
Does progress here mean the study or the staff?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the analysis listings stays with the data manager

incremental.description: Keep the listing columns aligned with the dataset

approvals.approved_version: reports the data manager accepted after reviewing the listings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If a second programmer must still build an independent table, that work stays, and the low end is the review of the listings, which stays either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The data manager still watches procedure compliance without a score of any person, still sets formatting rules, still designs the form fields, and still accepts listings before they are filed. No dashboard of individual staff performance is built.

A clinical monitor reads a progress report the data manager accepted

Setting format rules rather than having a model choose them
Reviewing a listing before it is filed
